resources.string: An addon is a web server that answers search and stream requests in JSON. Nothing it sends is ever run as code. Test the address, then add it.
What the source says the stream is. A value marked inferred was not stated by the source but deduced from a quality label or a file extension.
Square is the default. The other icons are BitChord\'s original artwork. Some launchers take a few seconds to show the change, and a home-screen shortcut made from a previous icon may disappear.
The stream is E-AC-3 JOC (Dolby Atmos) and a Dolby decoder was chosen. Square\'s player then mixes it to stereo, so Atmos is present in the stream but not rendered as Atmos.
The stream is E-AC-3 JOC (Dolby Atmos), but it is decoded to a downmix: Atmos is not active.
Android asks for the Nearby devices permission to read which codec Bluetooth uses. Without it the codec stays unknown and everything else works as before.

Every YouTube Music song goes through Square\'s mixer (crossfade, speed, pitch, reverb), which works at a fixed 48 kHz. A 96 or 192 kHz stream is resampled to 48 kHz there, and the decoder hands it 16-bit samples: this is the quality actually heard.
Sources, in the order they are asked

JioSaavn has no public API. This source uses the private one its own website uses: it can stop working at any time, is not authorised by JioSaavn, only serves some regions, and its streams cannot be downloaded. Never lossless (AAC, 320 kbps at best).
Downloads not allowed by this source
No source: every song plays from YouTube Music, as in Square.

YouTube Music: each song is turned down by its own loudness (loudnessDb) when YouTube provides it; quiet songs are not boosted. Songs from another source are left alone. Spotify keeps its engine\'s own normalisation, so nothing is normalised twice.

Off: Square\'s own behaviour. On: the chosen rate is asked of Android, which may still decide otherwise (battery saver, heat, the phone\'s own rules). Only the rate read back from the screen is shown as applied.
%1$d Hz was asked for but has not been confirmed by the system.
not offered by this screen at its current resolution

The quality asked of your addon sources. When none of them has the song at that quality, YouTube Music plays it with the quality chosen above. Lossless is accepted only when the source states a lossless codec.
The Spotify session has expired or was refused. Sign in again.
Sign in on Spotify\'s own page. Square Fusion never sees your password; it keeps the page\'s session cookie, encrypted, on this phone.

For browsing your Spotify playlists and covers; songs play through YouTube Music. This uses Spotify\'s web player, not a public API: it may break when Spotify changes it, and Spotify\'s terms do not allow unofficial clients.
Spotify answered in an unexpected way (its private API may have changed)
Tap a song to search for it on YouTube Music.
